note: Read the Banking Law (Royal Decree 114/2000) on cbo.gov.om: Article 18(c) requires the Central Bank of Oman's accounts to be audited by 'auditors, independent of the Central Bank, selected by His Majesty the Sultan', and Article 38 refers back to those auditors, but no firm is named. The CBO annual report listing page (cbo.gov.om/Pages/AnnualReport.aspx) says the report contains the independent auditor's report to the Board of Governors but does not name the auditor; the annual report PDFs are served from publishing.bnet.om, which is robots-disallowed and could not be fetched. No firm name obtainable.

The BEAC publishes the commissaires aux comptes' general report and certified IFRS financial statements (e.g. 'BEAC Etats financiers IFRS certifies 2021', 'Rapport general de la BEAC 2024', 'BEAC Rapport General des CAC Exercice clos au 31 decembre 2017'), but every one of these documents is hosted on beac.int, which returns robots_disallowed to fetching; two attempts failed. A news article found instead (ecomatin.net) named RSM France only as auditor of a one-off recruitment competition, not of the Bank's accounts. No auditor name could be read from a source.

No source read stating who audits the Central Bank of Jordan. Searches surfaced only Jordanian commercial-bank governance codes and the Audit Bureau's general remit; the Thomson Reuters 'Chapter 7 Accounts of the Central Bank' and 'Chapter 4 Accounts and Financial Statements' pages that looked like the CBJ law turned out to be the Central Bank of Bahrain law. The open-data file on portal.jordan.gov.jo that looked like CBJ financial statements was the Deposit Insurance Corporation's. The CBJ's own financial statements were not located in search results.

No source read naming the auditor of the National Bank of Rwanda. Searches returned only the draft BNR law on parliament.gov.rw (already known from a previous round), news commentary on the new central bank law, and commercial banks' statements. bnr.rw/index.php?id=82 is a JavaScript-only shell with no readable content. Neither the enacted law's audit article nor a BNR annual report naming a firm could be reached.

The National Bank of Ethiopia publishes 'audited financial statement' files at nbe.gov.et/files/audited-financial-statement-june-2024/ and .../audited-financial-statements-june-2022/, but both returned client errors when fetched and no text was retrieved. No other source read named the auditor, and no proclamation text naming an audit body was reached.

Read incidentally while looking for Jordan: Article 35(a) of the Central Bank of Bahrain and Financial Institutions Law 2006 (Decree No. 64 of 2006) states 'An external auditor shall audit The Central Bank's accounts' and provides that the Board decides the appointment and fees in coordination with the National Audit Court. No firm is named, so this is not a record.
